## Your rights under 10 CCR § 2644.9 [src:fixture_ccr_title10_2644_9_2022-10-14]
- Score request: your insurer must give your wildfire score in writing within 15 days of a completed application, at least 45 days before renewal and at least 75 days before nonrenewal [src:fixture_ccr_title10_2644_9_2022-10-14]
- Revised score: within 30 days of your request after you complete a mitigation measure [src:fixture_ccr_title10_2644_9_2022-10-14]
- Appeal: you can appeal orally or in writing; the insurer acknowledges in writing within 10 calendar days and decides within 30 days [src:fixture_ccr_title10_2644_9_2022-10-14]
- Check that the insurer's explanation covers:
  - The range of possible scores
  - Where your home falls in that range and how that affects your premium
  - A detailed explanation of the score
  - Mitigation that would lower your score
  - The premium reduction each of those measures would bring
- The insurer's response must include the Department of Insurance consumer hotline and the address of its Consumer Complaint Center.
